_comment: ── 完工门的【kind 需求表】（t54）──────────────────────────────【这里放的是表，不是逻辑】。三条门（r5 / mutation / backtest）每次求值时读它 ⇒ 改这个文件不需要重载插件。★ 而「怎么用这张表判」留在代码里 —— 一个能表达逻辑的数据文件会变成不可测的解释器。
_why: 为什么要有这张表（MEASURED）：那三条门此前各自写死 kind !== implementation && kind !== repair ⇒ 而 TASK_KINDS 有 7 个 ⇒ 5 个 kind 完全没有完工门。★ 而那【不是设计】—— 没有任何地方说 verification 类任务不需要新测试，它只是【默认】。⇒ 表把默认变成决定：每一个 kind 都要明写它要什么，或明写它为什么不要。量化：今天 51 个真实任务里 15 个（29%）属于无门的 kind。
_requiredGates: 每个 kind 要求哪些门。★ 空数组【必须】配一条 because —— 「不要求」是一个决定，而它要有理由；没有理由的空数组就是默认。★ 而【表里没有这个 kind】是另一回事：那是没能测量，门必须报 unmeasured（不是沉默）。

kinds.because: new behaviour needs a new test (r5: it must be red before and green after), that test must actually discriminate (mutation), and the change must not break what was working (backtest). This is the status quo, stated.

a repair's discriminating evidence is an EXISTING fixture that changes verdict (t31 established this); demanding new tests here would push members towards writing decorative ones. Mutation stays because it is what proves the discriminating fixture really discriminates; backtest stays because a repair is still a change.

a verification task adds no behaviour, so there is nothing new for r5/mutation to discriminate — requiring them would be requiring a test of a test. But it DOES run the suite, and a verification whose claimed result disagrees with a backtest is exactly the failure this class must not have. Not required: r5 (no new behaviour to pin), mutation (its subject is code, not a verdict).
kinds._history: ★ t73 修的冲突（这份数据与它自己的 because 互相否，而两者从 f8fc671 起就在一起）：上面那句 because 一直写着 `Not required: r5`，而 requiredGates 里却放着 `completion.r5`。⇒ 数据错了，because 是对的。MEASURED（t73，真跑 r5 的 gate()）：verification 任务按定义不新增测试（newTestFiles: []）⇒ r5 开火后必然落 ③ 那条支路，报 'R5 could not locate the new test files: none of the 0 reported file(s) resolve to a test path inside [scripts]' ⇒ unmeasured；而完工位置对 unmeasured 的处置是拒绝（t69 那条出口）⇒ ★ 于是「要 r5」这一格的真实后果是：每一个 verification 任务都无法完工。★ 而那不是“严格”，是一条永远不能为真的门：r5 问的是「有没有一条新测试，红前绿后」，而 verification 类按定义不产出那个东西 ⇒ 它对这个 kind 只有那一个答案，且那个答案与它要问的事无关。★ 曾经写在这里、而被删掉的立场（完整保留，供下一个提出它的人读到）：「要 r5」—— 理由大约是「verification 会跑套件，而 r5 问的正是有没有东西被判别」。它错在三处：① r5 的判据是整个 update.newTestFiles 的红前绿后，不是“跑没跑套件”（跑套件是 backtest 的问法，而 backtest 留着）；② 于是它在本 kind 上恒落 unmeasured，而“恒不可测量”与“严格”在读数上相反；③ 那条理由本身也没能写出来 —— 它只是 requiredGates 里多出来的一格。⇒ 保留这一段是为了让下一个人先读到结论，而不是重新发现一次这个冲突。

kinds.because: same shape as verification — the deliverable is a judgement, so there is no new behaviour for r5/mutation to pin. backtest stays for the same reason: a review that ran things must not have broken them. ★ And a review's real quality bar (did it find anything, was it independent) is not something these three gates can ask — pretending otherwise would be a gate that checks the wrong thing. That gap is honestly left open here rather than papered over.

a requirements task produces prose. There is no behaviour to pin (r5), no code for a mutation to survive, and — in the common case — nothing executable to break. ★ But this is an empty array WITH a reason, not a default: if a requirements task ever does touch executable surface, that is a contract/scope question (declared paths), not a completion-gate question. Keeping it empty deliberately: a gate that cannot fail for the right reason trains people to ignore it.

integration moves and rewires existing, already-tested parts — so the interesting question is not whether there is a new test (there is no new behaviour) but whether wiring them together broke something that worked alone. That is exactly backtest's question. Not required: r5 (no new behaviour to be red-then-green), mutation (the parts were already mutation-tested where they were written).

work is the kind whose contract deliberately does not require a verify list or an inScope at all (see contract.build-artifact-scope). Asking r5/mutation/backtest of it would demand evidence that its own contract never asked it to produce. ★ Empty WITH a reason: if a task needs completion gates, that is a signal it should have been filed as a quality kind — and that is a task-shaping decision, made visible here rather than silently enforced.
